0	"These are the generations of Yitzchak son of Avraham; Avraham begot Yitzchak. And Yitzchak was forty years old when he took Rivka, daughter of	"Estas são as gerações de Yitzchak, filho de Avraham; Avraham gerou Yitzchak. E Yitzchak tinha quarenta anos quando tomou Rivká, filha de
1	Betuel the Aramean, of Padan Aram, sister of Lavan the Aramean, as his wife."	Betuel, o arameu, de Padan Aram, irmã de Lavan, o arameu, por mulher."
2	Seemingly, such a verse is puzzling, because it repeats itself endlessly with things we already knew.	À primeira vista, esse versículo é estranho, porque se repete sem fim com coisas que já sabíamos.
3	"Yitzchak was forty years old when he took Rivka" — we already knew she was the daughter of Betuel, we knew, "the Aramean of Padan Aram,"	"Yitzchak tinha quarenta anos quando tomou Rivká" — já sabíamos que ela era filha de Betuel, já sabíamos, "o arameu de Padan Aram",
4	we knew that too.	isso também já sabíamos.
5	"Sister of Lavan the Aramean, as his wife" — Aramean again. So why all this length?	"Irmã de Lavan, o arameu, por mulher" — arameu outra vez. Então por que toda essa extensão?
6	Rashi comes to explain the words of the Midrash: "Like a rose among the thorns, so is my beloved among the daughters."	Rashi vem explicar as palavras do Midrash: "Como a rosa entre os espinhos, assim é minha amada entre as filhas."
7	Just as a rose has thorns all around it, so Rivka was such a great tzaddeket, she had such	Assim como a rosa tem espinhos ao redor, Rivká era uma tsadeket tão grande, tinha um mérito tão

9	What did Rivka hear at home?	O que Rivká ouvia em casa?
10	What did she hear in Rivka's house?	O que ela ouvia na casa de Rivká?
11	Every time she heard all kinds of things from criminals, all kinds of...	Toda hora ouvia todo tipo de coisa de criminosos, todo tipo de...
12	"Take him down, don't take him down, buy it, burn it."	"Derruba ele, não derruba, compra, queima."
13	What would she hear?	O que ela ouviria?
14	What did she hear?	O que ela ouvia?
15	Yitzchak, on the other hand, was entirely holiness.	Yitzchak, ao contrário, era todo santidade.
16	Yitzchak saw only a personal example and a personal model from his father, Avraham.	Yitzchak via apenas o exemplo pessoal e o modelo pessoal do pai, Avraham.
17	He would host guests, he would run in the heat of the day — page 10, tractate Sotah.	Ele recebia hóspedes, corria no calor do dia — folha 10, tratado Sotá.
18	The Gemara says his house was open on all four sides of the heavens in order to receive guests.	A Guemará diz que a casa dele era aberta para os quatro ventos do céu a fim de receber hóspedes.
19	And so Yitzchak was surely a perfect olah offering, wholesome.	Por isso Yitzchak certamente era uma oferenda olá perfeita, íntegra.
20	He learned from the house of his father, Avraham; he saw how Avraham, his father, would give himself over	Ele aprendeu na casa do pai, Avraham; via como Avraham, seu pai, se entregava

22	under the wings of the Shechinah.	sob as asas da Shechiná.
